coverage.name: Greater Mogadishu
coverage.description: Rectangular extract covering the OSM Banaadir administrative boundary and the northern and western urban fringe. This is a data coverage area, not a new administrative boundary.

fullGeometry.description: Exported OSM geometries and their original tags. The PBF also preserves OSM relations and non-geometric objects.

limitations: OSM coverage is incomplete. Unmapped heights, facades and entrances are estimates. This is not photographic 3D.
